Title: Generally available: Azure Site Recovery update rollup 60 - January 2022

Body.Content:
This update provides the following improvements for the latest version of Azure Site Recovery components.

  • Mobility Service  
    • Added new distros to Linux OS support for Azure to Azure and VMware/Physical to Azure replications. 
    • Added support for Windows Server 2022 for Hyper-V to Azure replications.
  • Microsoft Azure Site Recovery (Service) 
    • Retention points are now available for up to 15 days.
    • Replication can be enabled on Azure virtual machines via Azure Policy.
    • ZRS managed disks can be used when replicating Azure virtual machines.

This update also provides bug fixes.

Learn more about the issues fixed and get the download links.
